confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not from inspected live listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is uncertain because of July peak-season pricing and wide variation across hostels and hotels. Cocktail and wine are estimated relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge is weaker. Anchors assume Swiss price levels in CHF converted at current USD rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Swiss tourist cities with high restaurant price levels and July peak-season accommodation demand, such as Zurich, Bern and Basel, scaled to Lucerne's smaller market.
